    'C:\\GIT\\wpf-framework\\src\\FrameworkUI\\Unsaved Elements\\SaveElementsDialog.xaml.cs',

foreach \($file in $files\) {
    $content = Get-Content $file -Raw
    # First replace fully qualified System.Windows.MessageBox.Show\(
    $content = $content -replace 'System\\.Windows\\.MessageBox\\.Show\\\(', 'GenericControls.MessageBox.Show\('
    # Then replace any remaining unqualified MessageBox.Show\( that isn't preceded by GenericControls.

    Set-Content $file $content -NoNewline
